name: Cube-Chordal Ample Classes Are Strictly Contained in Dismantlable Ample Classes
scope: Finite nonempty ample classes under the signed-coordinate and full ambient complement conventions; hierarchy parameters are held fixed.
statement: Every member of Cube-Chordal Ample Classes belongs to Dismantlable Ample Classes.
proof: Cube-retaining corner peeling gives dismantlability. The explicit ten-word class is dismantlable and has an induced four-cycle among maximal cubes.
